dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Features multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-intensity, thin white perimeters. A central pair forms a figure-eight configuration with sharp outer gradients transitioning to lower-intensity grey interiors. Surrounding structures exhibit crenulated, irregular, and fragmented perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid, non-gradient pixel clusters. Localized high-intensity pixel groups lacking internal gradients are restricted to the base of the pectoral flipper and the lower ventral edge, primarily corresponding to specular reflections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the dorsal-central region form an obtuse scalene triangle. An alignment of four smaller ring structures forms a curvilinear trajectory extending toward the posterior region.
